g.text: Cache Miss Stampede: One Expired Key, Four Concurrent Readers
The one hard problem a shared cache tier has to solve: don't let a hot key's cold moment become a database incident.
Four concurrent readers miss the same expiring key at the same instant.
Without coalescing, every reader queries the database independently -- 4 queries for 1 key.
With a cluster-wide fetching marker, only the first reader queries the database -- the other 3 wait and share its result.
